stories.title: Detenidos cinco hombres con explosivos cerca de una base británica utilizada por el ejército estadounidense: "Querían causar grandes daños"

en.title: Five men arrested with explosives near British base used by US military: "They wanted to cause major damage"
en.summary: Five men were detained near a British military base used by the US military while in possession of explosives. Trump stated that the suspects had been under US surveillance for an extended period.

stories.title: Zverev corona a Europa en la Laver Cup y deja sin jugar a Alcaraz y Jódar

en.title: Zverev crowns Europe in Laver Cup and leaves Alcaraz and Jódar without playing
en.summary: Alexander Zverev defeated Learner Tien to clinch Europe's victory at the Laver Cup in London, with the European team winning 13-5 and securing the trophy without needing their Spanish players Alcaraz and Jódar.

stories.title: La policía británica detiene a cinco sospechosos por manejar explosivos cerca de la base militar aérea de Fairford

en.title: British police arrest five suspects for handling explosives near Fairford air force base
en.summary: British police arrested five individuals found with explosives near Fairford air force base, with investigators suspecting preparation of a potential terrorist attack.

stories.title: Sánchez apremia a los socios a apoyar el decreto de vivienda “por Maricarmen y los millones de españoles que sufren la crisis”

en.title: Sánchez urges coalition partners to support housing decree "for Maricarmen and millions of Spaniards suffering the crisis"
en.summary: Spanish President Sánchez pressured his coalition partners to support a housing decree, characterizing the vote as a humanitarian matter and stating he is working to approve it by Tuesday.

stories.title: Sánchez ignora las críticas por su gestión de la vivienda y responde a la presión de la calle: "El Gobierno trabaja contrarreloj para llevar el martes el decreto"

en.title: Sánchez ignores criticism over his housing management and responds to street pressure: "The Government works around the clock to bring the decree on Tuesday"
en.summary: Spain's president asks his coalition partners for a final effort to validate housing legislation and shifts responsibility to Congress for its approval.

stories.title: Sánchez asegura a Maricarmen que “trabaja contra reloj” para aprobar el decreto antidesahucios

en.title: Sánchez assures Maricarmen that he "works around the clock" to approve the anti-eviction decree
en.summary: The Spanish president requests coalition parties make one more effort to reach agreement on housing measures and calls for housing protests to translate into electoral support against opposition leaders.

stories.title: Un hombre mata a su pareja y se entrega tras atrincherarse durante horas en una casa de La Campana (Sevilla)

en.title: A man kills his partner and surrenders after barricading himself for hours in a house in La Campana (Seville)
en.summary: A 56-year-old man was detained after killing his 47-year-old partner and barricading himself in a home in Seville before surrendering.

stories.title: Detenido tras matar a puñaladas a su pareja y atrincherarse durante horas en una casa de La Campana (Sevilla)

en.title: Detained after stabbing his partner to death and barricading himself for hours in a house in La Campana (Seville)
en.summary: A 56-year-old man surrendered to specialized Civil Guard units after fatally stabbing his partner and barricading himself in a Seville residence.

stories.title: La Policía Nacional desmantela un asentamiento de inmigrantes junto a la desalinizadora de Ceuta

en.title: National Police dismantle immigrant settlement next to Ceuta desalination plant
en.summary: Spanish National Police conducted a special operation involving 300 officers to dismantle an immigrant settlement located near a desalination facility in Ceuta.

stories.title: Detenido el hombre atrincherado en su domicilio tras matar a su pareja en Sevilla

en.title: Man barricaded in his home arrested after killing his partner in Seville
en.summary: A man was arrested in Seville after barricading himself in his residence following the death of his partner.

stories.title: Desalojado el otro asentamiento de inmigrantes en la playa próxima a la desaladora de Ceuta

en.title: Immigrant settlement evacuated from beach near Ceuta desalination plant
en.summary: Over 300 police officers carried out an operation to evacuate migrants from a beach settlement near Ceuta's desalination facility, relocating them to nearby alternative accommodation.

stories.title: La policía desaloja el asentamiento en la playa ceutí de Benítez, próxima a la desalinizadora

en.title: Police evict settlement at Ceuta's Benítez beach, near desalination plant
en.summary: Authorities relocated immigrants from a beach settlement to a nearby open area as suitable accommodation facilities remain unavailable.

stories.title: El 'decreto Maricarmen' no sirve al vulnerable

en.title: The 'Maricarmen decree' fails to help the vulnerable
en.summary: Critics argue that a political decree prioritizes property interests over addressing the needs of vulnerable populations.

stories.title: Bill Gates advierte que la IA sin control podría causar "1.000 millones de muertes"

en.title: Bill Gates warns that uncontrolled AI could cause "1 billion deaths"
en.summary: Microsoft's co-founder cautioned that artificial intelligence in the wrong hands could be powerful enough to trigger catastrophic events resulting in a billion deaths.

stories.title: Pedro Sánchez confirma que el Gobierno trabaja en un decreto sobre vivienda

en.title: Pedro Sánchez confirms that the Government is working on a housing decree
en.summary: The Spanish Government is preparing a Royal Decree on housing to present to the Cabinet next Tuesday.

stories.title: Cientos de personas acampan en Sol por la vivienda: "O cae el rentismo, o cae el Gobierno"

en.title: Hundreds camp at Sol over housing: "Either rentism falls, or the Government falls"
en.summary: Protesters established a camp in central Madrid following a demonstration against evictions, voicing demands related to housing policies.

stories.title: Cinco perfumes de hombre perfectos para usar en otoño

en.title: Five men's perfumes perfect for wearing in autumn
en.summary: A selection of fragrances combines fresh citrus notes with warmer woods and spices suited for the autumn season.
